The service reads the selected app's screen and carries out commands inside that app only.

To know when to wait, it checks the name of the app in front. It does not read, tap or type in any other app.

• New menu with separate settings pages, All Settings, and this About page
• New Home screen with status, warnings, and Start and Stop
• Choose Scheduled commands or Auto reply, one at a time. Auto reply has its own Start, Stop, hours, and channel, and can react to notifications
• Each command has its own interval and daily schedule, following the real clock
• Returns to the selected app 5 seconds before a scheduled send
• A Daily command without valid times stays idle until you set them
• Redesigned floating timer with a size setting, a blue theme, and a new icon
No browser is available to open this page.

Settings and the event log are stored only on this device, and backups are turned off. Channel names are encrypted. The log holds times and event types, never chat text. With notification access on, only the selected app\'s notifications are read, and their text is never saved. The app has no internet permission.
YOUSE TIMER is an unofficial app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the selected app.

Only the selected app\'s notifications are read, and their text is never saved. If Android blocks the switch, allow restricted settings from App info first.
Find this app in the list and turn it on, so Auto reply can see triggers in the selected app\'s notifications. Without it, screen triggers still work. If Android blocks the switch, repeat step 1.
